reviews.author: Jamie Garling
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs completely saved my yard. I had someone else do work prior and I was still having issues. What used to turn into a full-on pond thanks to a natural spring is now totally under control. They fixed it with smart trenching and regrading, and the difference is night and day. Finally, I'll have a usable yard again. They also added a simplistic stepping stone walkway from my deck to my utility room which I've always wanted and it turned out great. Great team, easy to work with, love dogs, reasonable pricing and results that speak for themselves. Highly recommend for any outdoor project you might be considering. They will be my first call for any other outdoor projects I'll need in the future.

reviews.author: Beth Kruse
reviews.text: We have used Jason and Infinite Outdoor designs for many years. They not only did lawn work but they took care of our snow removal. I highly recommend them. I asked if they would come to Tacoma WA where I moved Burt they said it was a bit too far! Thanks for years of a beautiful lawn

reviews.author: kajan gnanasakthy
reviews.text: We used Infinite Outdoor Designs to remove a retaining wall and regrade the area, and we’re very happy with the results. Our original plan was to replace the retaining wall, but Jason was very transparent about the cost and overall impact of doing so. Instead, he suggested removing the wall and regrading the area since it wasn’t a space we really used. That option ended up being much more cost-effective and aligned better with our long-term plans than we had originally realized. Jason and his team were professional, careful, and respectful throughout the entire project. They took extra care to avoid damaging the rest of our property with their equipment, put everything back where it belonged, and left the area clean when the job was done. It has now been about two weeks, the grass is already growing in nicely, and we’re extremely happy with how everything turned out.

reviews.author: Jessica Marhevka
reviews.text: Jason and his team are absolutely amazing! A pleasure to work with and spot on attention to detail. Our backyard has been beautifully transformed and we could not be more pleased with the outcome.

reviews.author: Larry Kaletcher
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs did a tremendous job cleaning up neglected landscaping at my place of employment. This consisted of pruning of shrubs, cutting back of grasses and perennials and a comprehensive property clean up. Additionally, they spread mulch all along the surrounding property. Jason's guys did a great job and very professional. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: ROBERT VENEZIA
reviews.text: Jason and the team were professional, reliable, and easy to work with from start to finish. The quality of the work exceeded my expectations, and they left everything clean when they were done. I highly recommend Infinite Outdoor Designs for any landscaping or outdoor project!

reviews.author: Anthony Diana
reviews.text: Jason and his crew are awesome took a few days longer than anticipated but that’s due to the quality and care they take in the installation. Highly recommend will be using them again.

reviews.author: Becky Snook
reviews.text: Jason and his team were wonderful to work with. During the initial meeting he explained the entire process of creating our new front wall. He explained the importance of proper drainage and care as well His team went above and beyond the basic services which they were hired to complete. The new wall looks beautiful and we are so pleased with the quality and design. Thank you Infinite outdoor design.

reviews.author: Erin Post
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs installed a nice concrete pad for some propane tanks. The crew was timely, neat and professional and the job came out great!

reviews.author: Adrian Douglas
reviews.text: The team at Infinite did a great job cleaning up unwanted plants/weeds in our yard prior to installing a retaining wall. Jason, the owner was quick to respond to our request and came out in person to explain there process and give ideas. Great process, team and results- Thanks again!

reviews.author: Stephanie V
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs completely transformed my home in Jefferson NJ. Before, we had an overgrown mess and Jason and his team transformed it with two patio areas, stone steps, a walkway, and river rock. He and his team went above and beyond every step of the way and I truly appreciated their professionalism and reliability! Looking forward to enjoying our space.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.text: Had some pavers re done and new stone poured. Good communication, good pricing, and prompt service. Highly recommend from small jobs like mine to big remodels!

reviews.author: mike marrapodi
reviews.text: Jason and his team did a great job from start to finish. From quick but detailed replies, explaining all planned services before they were started, actual services preformed to cleanup of the job, all areas Infinite Outdoor Designs exceeded our expectations. We will surely be in touch once we are ready for more projects in the future.

reviews.author: Damian Conklin
reviews.text: Jason and his teams work is nothing short of amazing. He knows how to build a wall once and make it last your lifetime. Not a hardscape you will need to replace in a few years. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Michelle Marrapodi
reviews.text: If anyone is looking to have landscaping, paver, retaining wall, drainage, Belgian block or driveway apron work done, we highly recommend Infinite Outdoor Designs LLC. Jason and his team have done a beautiful job at addressing all issues and areas of concern. They were able to get a relatively quick start after our original contractor backed out because of being over booked and worked relatively quickly throughout the process. Thankfully someone else on Facebook highly recommended this company, which is how we found them. We ended up replacing our driveway apron, installing belgian block along the driveway, installed a retaining wall along the fenceline on the top right of the driveway to give a finished look and restrain the soil from spilling into our driveway due to sloped elevation, buried drainage and created a properly installed well under our front lawn, which removed the ugly drain pipe that ran from the back of the house, along the side of the house attaching to the front and under some old bushes, which drained out to our sidewalk. It’s the complete makeover that we hoped for and we are looking forward to more improvements next spring. Before and after (or work in progress) photos attached.

reviews.author: Trish O
reviews.text: We’d give Infinite Outdoor Designs 10 stars if had them! I contacted them for the big snowstorm to schedule plowing my parents’ driveway since my dad had a heart procedure and couldn’t shovel at all and I wasn’t going to be able to get to his house to even attempt to dig them out for days after. They communicated promptly and professionally and did a fantastic job clearing a huge amount of snow and making a safe walkway to their door working late into the night. We were so pleased with their thoroughness and also appreciated that they were upfront and honest with the estimate for the job. We would definitely recommend this company and will not hesitate to contact them again for future landscaping needs, in every season.

reviews.author: Jacie Woznicki
reviews.text: After years of researching and debating how to redo our front yard's old and collapsing retaining walls, we finally hired Jay & his team to tear them out and replace them for us. We are pretty experienced DIYers, but we wanted an expert to handle this project, and are so glad we did! The process was smooth from start to finish. Jay was highly communicative, from visiting the property to take measurements and discuss our project goals, to answering all our questions and making adjustments on the fly once the work was underway. Our project had a few challenges, like lots of big rocks hiding in the ground that needed removal, and the fact we chose wall block that required extra steps to install, all of which Jay handled with professionalism and ease. The work was completed on time and on budget, and we are super happy with the results. Literally all of our neighbors have told us how great it looks, too! We still have to do some planting this fall in the empty mulch beds, but Jay's work provided us with the perfect clean slate to start from.

reviews.author: Robin Augustine Fichter
reviews.text: Due to hours of windy weather and lots of snow remaining, it created a some major snow drifts in my driveway and made it impassable. I was so impressed when I reached out to Infinite Outdoor Designs as a recommended by another first time customer explained my demise with my driveway from the day before high winds, it was on a Sunday. I was surprised and relieved that without hesitation they would be at my home same day, within a few hours to plow/clear my driveway. The driver of the plow truck did an excellent job clearing my driveway making it usable again as well. I highly recommend this company and I am very happy to be a new customer.

reviews.author: Celeste Luciano
reviews.text: Thanks so much to the team at Infinite Outdoor Designs! I was left in the lurch this season and they came through with an amazing Spring clean up. I'm so impressed with their professionalism and reputation, I'm using them for my stone wall and walkway repair. Looking forward to the next projects!

reviews.author: Joseph Triano
reviews.text: Jason and his team are hands down the best around! From professional customer service to work completed, I couldn't be happier with the outcome of our patio. He was able to provide us with 3D renderings to show us what it would look like before the project even started. Very impressed with everything! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vincet Lalane
reviews.text: I was shoveling snow for damn near an hour and only like half way through jason comes in i wave my hand and he says hell clear all the snow in the front this guy is the greatest. Saved me like 3 hours worth of work.

reviews.author: David Landreth
reviews.text: I have been a customer for 5+ years and they have done a great job with my lawn, leaves, and snow removal. I hired them to replace my outdoor steps, walkway, retaining wall, and add a stone lining of my driveway which resulted in all amazing comments from my friends. I always recommend them to anyone asking for a landscaper.

reviews.author: Mauro Mastrofilippo
reviews.text: Jason was very professional. His crew was efficient and polite. I would recommend Infinite Outdoor Designs for all your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Mikki Coscolluela
reviews.text: We have Infinite Outdoor Designs do snow plowing for our driveway. Despite issues through no fault of theirs, they are still receptive and did a great job. I would highly recommend. Looking forward to having them do our yard work for the warmer seasons!

reviews.author: Chris Patterson
reviews.text: Helped us out in a pinch with moving some huge snow mounds and it was all done in a tinely manner and for a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Cara Pelchat
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs added a rock border around our new pool patio. They were professional and communicative throughout the process and it turned out great.

reviews.author: Jake Lachenauer
reviews.text: Jason and his team did incredible work on my new patio in Morristown NJ, my backyard look like a resort now, my house is now the spot for hangout and events, I couldn’t be more pleased with the level of professionalism, knowledge and respect they had for my property and even when I followed up with a bunch of question he never made me feel like I was annoying or a bother! if you need any work done this is the company to go with NO questions asked

reviews.author: Mary Bennett
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience working with Jason on my landscaping project. He was professional, reliable, and detail-oriented from start to finish. Jason took the time to understand my vision, offered helpful suggestions, and executed the work beautifully. The results exceeded my expectations, everything looks clean, well-structured, and polished. His communication was clear, his pricing was fair, and the quality of work speaks for itself. I would highly recommend Jason to anyone looking for top-notch landscaping services.

reviews.author: Jorge Hinojosa
reviews.text: I was shoveling what felt like a mountain of snow during a heavy snowstorm when Jason showed up out of nowhere with his truck and asked if I needed help clearing the entrance to my driveway. He didn’t ask for anything in return, he just genuinely wanted to help. I’m extremely grateful for his kindness and for stepping in when he saw me struggling. Thank you, Jason, for your help and generosity.

reviews.author: mark mastandrea
reviews.text: Jason and his staff did a great job and had a great attitude throughout the work day. Price and quality of work were great.

reviews.author: Lucille Pearce
reviews.text: Infinite Designs has been a reliable, consistent landscaping company. I have had these gentlemen care for my property since the day the company were created. The work ethic of the company is superior to others I have hired. The work is done efficiently and in a timely manner. I highly recommend ID.

reviews.author: Diane Hyland
reviews.text: We’ve been using Infinite Outdoor for several years now and we couldn’t be happier with how well they healed our lawn! We had issues with it that Jason took the time to show us, explain how to fix it and took great care to get it done. And I greatly appreciate how they follow up to be sure the process is going well! Quality and integrity is important to them and it shows in their work as well as their customer service. Very professional. I highly recommend this company!!!

reviews.author: J Tay
reviews.text: Jason from Infinite is fantastic. Work is top class, professional, responsible. Will be working with them again in the future, I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Carol Tomensky
reviews.text: We’ve used Infinite Outdoor Designs for many years and are always thrilled with the results! They keep our lawn looking pristine and Jason has made great suggestions to enhance our property, from planting trees and bushes to thoughtful upgrades. Always reliable, professional, and a pleasure to work with. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tara Kinney
reviews.text: I have known Jason for 14 years and he is by far one of the hardest workers I know. He has a way with understanding a vision and exceeding the customers expectations with precision and perfectionism. He is very loyal individual and the kind of person you can trust with creating a space that you could only dream of. He does not stop until the job is done even though he is a dedicated family man! I would trust him with any job knowing that he would give 110% and making sure it is not complete until the vision has become a reality!

reviews.author: Chris Lockwood
reviews.text: Not only does Infinite Outdoor Designs do my regular lawncare, but I have had them do multiple lanscape projects in my yard. The crew is nice and courteous. They mow quickly efficiently and without issue. Jason continues to do projects in my yard. He has transformed my yard into a clean comfortable place to spend time. Infinite is a professional company that offers excellent service at an very fair price. I highly recommend looking into the services Infinite Outdoor Designs provides.

reviews.author: Joe Delloiacovo
reviews.text: Jason and his team has provided services to Cathy and I for many years. Landscaping, lawn care, snow removal and other services have been outstanding. They are extremely reliable and professional with exceptional pride in their work and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Donna Feuss
reviews.text: My property has never looked better!! I use infinite for mulching and mowing. Always meticulously done. Spring and fall clean ups look perfect. They are expensive but their work is a cut above the rest!

reviews.author: Justin Jacobus
reviews.text: It has been a real pleasure to have infinite outdoors.Taken care of my lawn maintenance Courteous and professional all the time.

reviews.author: Lisa Rocha
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoor Designs is an awesome company. Jason and his crew are great. They work hard. I have been one of their clients for several years. They take pride in their work. My yard has never looked better. I highly recommend you give them a call for any outdoor project you may be considering for your yard.

reviews.author: Brandi Kitchell
reviews.text: Working with Infinite Outdoor Design was such a pleasure! They took the time to visit my property and came up with a variety of creative ideas. They offered so many options and really worked with my budget. I couldn’t be happier with the experience and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: The Shusters
reviews.text: Our patio needed a facelift and Jason made it happen! We had a vision, and Jason added suggestions to made it even better. He and his crew recreated our space so that we can once again enjoy sitting out in our backyard.

reviews.author: shawn dean
reviews.text: I’ve know Jason for years he takes pride in his work and will get the job done with respect and integrity if you want a vacation every time you walk into your yard I highly recommend Infinite outdoor design he will get the job done right the first time great guy and Company to do business with!

reviews.author: Andrew Maragulia
reviews.text: The crew from Infinite Outdoor Designs did such an amazing job with our new front walk, that we decided to let them design and build our backyard patio! They showed us many designs and options and the final results were incredible!! We would absolutely use them again and I recommend them for your next outdoor construction project! A++

reviews.author: joe lawson
reviews.text: Awesome people to deal with. They are extremely professional and they have such creative ideas to turn your yard into your oasis. The work they do is such an incredible masterpiece. Once you use them you want call anyone eles!

reviews.author: Edward Klecha
reviews.text: I have been a customer of Infinite Outdoor Designs for a few years now . I have nothing but positive things to say about them as a landscape provider and give my highest recommendation. Their prices are fair, and they communicate effectively. Best of all, it's inspiring to see guys like Jeff & Jason working with a true passion for what they do!

reviews.author: Patricia Logan
reviews.text: Jason and Jeff are professional, courteous, and a pleasure to do business with! Their quotes are detailed, and their response to emails and texts is prompt. Thanks to the two of them and their hard-working, polite employees, our yard looks incredible!

reviews.author: Kevin Hollingsworth
reviews.text: This is my tenth season with this company. They continue to perform to high standards, with professionalism, and excellence. From large projects to weekly yard maintenance, their work consistently exceeds my expectations. Jeff and Jason are knowledgeable, accommodating, and hard working. I could not be happier with the results.

reviews.author: Alyssa Guagenti
reviews.text: We hired this landscaping company to redo our play area and landscape for our above-ground pool. They were extremely professional and did a fantastic job. The project involved a lot of work, including building a great retaining wall, planting shrubs, and grading the land. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jeffery Smith
reviews.text: These guys were awesome! They did an entire restoration of my 1.2 acre property. Very reasonable and very responsive. Neighbors and friends have said my property now looks like a resort. I am glad to have them as my reoccurring landscaping team. Bravo!

reviews.author: Shari Rimberg
reviews.text: These guys do a great job plowing and shoveling! If you need any service, they are the guys to do it!!

reviews.author: stephen Froitzheim
reviews.text: Had a UPS truck back onto my grass and made some deep ruts. Called infinite outdoor designs and they were able to get my house fix the ruts and mulch as well. Very professional and got the job done quick

reviews.author: Dan Kostecki
reviews.text: I’ve been a customer of Infinite for a long time and they do great work, they’re great to work with and I would highly recommend them. They have done a bit of everything for my home and not once have I had a complaint!

reviews.author: Bill Vanderwende jr
reviews.text: These guys did a great job! Cleaned up a crazy steep hill I had and put down a bunch of mulch. Looks awesome!!

reviews.author: Jack Smith
reviews.text: Yard has never looked as good. Great group of guys. They are born and raised here and truly care about this area. I’d pick them over a big commercial company any day.

reviews.author: Brian Gruchacz
reviews.text: Came up with a great design layout and front yard refresh. Pleased with the results. Easy to work with and good value.

reviews.author: Niccole Scully
reviews.text: Jason responds quickly and answered all my questions He does amazing work !! I Will be using him again in the future

reviews.author: Robert Filowitz
reviews.text: Very professional and communicative throughout the process. Take great care in quality of their work. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brad Holley
reviews.text: I have had Infinite do landscaping and landscaping and always were professional on time and did very nice work.

reviews.author: marybeth penczak
reviews.text: Infinite Outdoors Designs provided outstanding service. Great people, great work. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: crystal laul
reviews.text: Professional, dedicated, and provides unmatched quality and experience, throughout the whole process. I would recommend Infinite Outdoor Designs to anyone in search of transforming their property!

reviews.author: Gary MacDonald
reviews.text: I had a great experience with them and they accomidiated my needs to what i wanted in a patio. Couldn't be happier

reviews.author: John Fantozzi
reviews.text: Excellent reliable service. Consistent and thorough. Driveway and walkway are cleared by 4am, which is greatly appreciated. Highly recommend, you wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Vivian Miskar
reviews.text: We used Infinite Outdoors for a large piece of our backyard that was overgrown. Over a couple years my husband and I pulled many bushes and removed trees that had fallen or have been removed. With that said this area became a weedy mess that was all unlevel to the point we couldn't get a lawn mower back there.. we needed help!! In came Infinite and his amazing crew to regrade and seed! I never thought the yard could look as amazing as it does and it opened so many possibilities for the yard. Pricing was very transparent and upfront with all the work and materials involved and even gave us a couple of options per different budgets. Highly reccoment using them as I will for future projects!!

reviews.author: Eric Dieterle
reviews.text: Amazing experience!! Jason was the best to work with. He communicated with us clearly and efficiently every step of the way. His crew was friendly and professional, and did fantastic work with our paver walkway, stair tread refresh, new railing install, foundation paint, and front yard re-grade / seeding. We will absolutely be having them back for more projects down the road

reviews.author: Laura Castles
reviews.text: Jason and his team were exceptional! They created a beautiful garden design for our front yard in an area that struggled to grow much of anything. They worked tirelessly and completed the garden in one day. They were professional and cleaned up the yard of any debris after the project was finished. We will definitely hire Jason and his crew at Infinite Outdoor Design Landscaping to work on other landscaping and hardscape projects we will have in the near future. Thank you Jason for going above and beyond!

reviews.author: Geoff Frick
reviews.text: Jason went above and beyond to volunteer his time and resources towards helping out with a service project to rehabilitate a local memorial site. He worked with local vendors to secure the materials needed, and his knowledge and professionalism helped engage all the young volunteers to make the project successful. Can't speak highly enough of his character and the work he does. Will highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Christopher Peters
reviews.text: High quality work and the experience to back it up! Give Infinite the opportunity to design your dream landscaping or backyard!

reviews.author: Jolene Strunz
reviews.text: Jay and his crew did an amazing job reimagining what our front walkway and front steps could be! We will be using them again for future projects.

reviews.author: Kerine
reviews.text: We hired Jason from Infinite Outdoor to help with our yard cleanup. He responded quickly, arrived on time, and did an amazing job. He was professional, efficient, and paid great attention to detail. We highly recommend him to anyone looking for quality landscaping and yard cleanup services.
